channel.title: Inspiration Grid — Illustration
channel.description: Recent illustration inspiration selected by Inspiration Grid.

item.title: Handcrafted Paper Illustrations by Mariia Lapitan-Yashchenko
item.description: Ukrainian paper artist Mariia Lapitan-Yashchenko crafts miniature worlds from cut and layered paper, tucking forests, gardens, and floral fields inside silhouettes of heads, eyes, and everyday objects.

item.title: Controlled Chaos: Psychedelic Illustrations by Meme MX
item.description: Mexican illustrator Carlos Mario Ochoa, aka Meme MX, creates wildly colorful compositions packed with surreal characters, futuristic machines, distorted architecture and strange objects that seem to collide within the same psychedelic universe.

item.title: Contemporary Engravings: Intricate Ink Illustrations by Pookiee
item.description: Thai artist Pookiee creates striking black and white illustrations using ink on paper, stacking thousands of individual strokes into portraits that borrow the density and discipline of classical engraving.

item.title: Shakespeare in Black & White: Sonnet Posters by Xtian Miller
item.description: Last year, we featured Xtian Miller’s experimental typographic posters, and this time we’re diving back into his catalog with Sonnet Posters, a project created between January 2018 and May 2020.

item.title: Shape-Shifting Figures: Illustrations by Gloria Pizzilli
item.description: Florence-based illustrator Gloria Pizzilli creates striking images that combine graceful linework, expressive figures and powerful color palettes.

item.title: Back to School: An A+ Collection of Design Assets
item.description: If there’s one thing I’ve learned from Rodney Dangerfield, it’s that going back to school is a lot more fun when you’re not the one doing the homework. We’ve rounded up a collection of design assets, all ready to go. Minimum effort required.

item.title: 20 Exceptional A’ Design Award Winners Worth Discovering
item.description: The A’ Design Award & Competition is one of the world’s largest international design competitions, recognizing outstanding work across architecture, product design, furniture, graphics, fashion, digital design, art and many other creative disciplines.

item.title: Myths, Monsters and Otherworldly Visions: Illustrations by Shirley Gong
item.description: Singapore-based illustrator Shirley Gong crafts intricate scenes packed with mythological creatures, strange spirits and surreal landscapes, blending traditional East Asian influences with a contemporary sensibility.

item.title: Geometric Figures Cast in Dramatic Light: Illustrations by Kyrellos Maximos
item.description: Cairo-based illustrator and designer Kyrellos Maximos uses simple forms, dramatic lighting and a strong sense of visual storytelling to craft ethereal images.

item.title: Between Motion and Memory: Illustrations by Yogi Fahmi Riandito
item.description: Yogi Fahmi Riandito is a Jakarta-based artist who creates expressive illustrations exploring a wide range of themes, from high-energy sports imagery and character-driven sketches to more peaceful, dreamlike landscapes.

item.title: Wild Encounters: Nick Liefhebber’s Colorful Campaign for ARTIS Zoo
item.description: Dutch designer and illustrator Nick Liefhebber created a vibrant visual world for Summer Nights at ARTIS Zoo in Amsterdam.

item.title: After Dark: Nighttime Wildlife Scenes by Nicholas Moegly
item.description: Midwestern illustrator and painter Nicholas Moegly creates atmospheric scenes suspended between the familiar and the uncanny.

item.title: Solitary Escapes: Dreamlike Illustrations by Leah Han
item.description: Illustrator and visual artist Leah Han creates calm worlds shaped by solitude, imagination and the sweet pleasure of one’s own company.

item.title: Hype&Hyper: A Magazine Shaped by Its Own Typography
item.description: Budapest-based designer and visual artist Miklós Kiss, aka kissmiklos, crafted a bold, highly graphic identity for Hype&Hyper, a Central and Eastern European magazine covering trends across strategy, business, design and lifestyle.

item.title: Illustrator Harol Bustos Renders Power and Myth in Screen-Printed Color
item.description: Chilean artist Harol Bustos creates atmospheric illustrations that turn complex stories into bold, cinematic images.

item.title: Heavy Hitters: Sharp Character Art by Léo Chiola
item.description: Quebec-based comic artist and illustrator Léo Chiola returns to the grid with his dynamic, high-impact character art.

item.title: Hand-Drawn Stories: Atmospheric Scenes by Henrique de França
item.description: Brazilian artist Henrique de França creates intriguing, unsettling worlds through graphite on paper.

item.title: Micro Machines: Mini Vehicle Renders by Auhapwrd
item.description: Digital artist Dhehaivan transforms familiar cars and motorcycles into playful pocket-sized machines through his ongoing project, Auhapwrd.

item.title: Surreal Collages and Visual Explorations by André Calvo
item.description: Brazilian designer, director and visual artist André Calvo brings together vintage engravings, botanical studies, scientific diagrams and contemporary imagery to create intricate collages.

item.title: Fragmented Portraits and Noir Symbolism: Illustrations by Hanna Marchanka
item.description: Belarusian illustrator and poster artist Hanna Marchanka creates powerful images where beauty, tension and symbolism often occupy the same frame.

item.title: Quirky Inflated 3D Characters by Josh McKenna
item.description: After more than a decade working as a freelance illustrator, London-based artist and designer Josh McKenna is embracing a playful new direction.

item.title: Handcrafted Worlds: Layered Papercut Art by Owen Gildersleeve
item.description: UK-based artist and designer Owen Gildersleeve has spent more than 15 years pushing the possibilities of paper, transforming simple sheets of card into layered illustrations filled with depth, texture and light.

item.title: Liquid Motion: Mesmerising 3D Experiments by Jakub Spacek
item.description: London-based FX designer Jakub Spacek explores the expressive potential of simulated liquids through a series of striking 3D experiments that combine physics, sculpture and digital art.

item.title: Illustrator 1000DAY Turns Loose iPad Linework Into Loud Color
item.description: South Korean illustrator and character designer Jang Suk-woo, better known as 1000DAY, fills his ongoing series of iPad sketches with bold color, loose gestures and an infectious sense of energy.

item.title: Playful Food-Fueled Characters by Pizza Chen
item.description: Taiwanese artist and character designer Pizza Chen transforms familiar foods into a playful cast of tiny heroes, monsters and mascots, each one packed with personality.

item.title: Sharp Silhouettes and Editorial Metaphors by Vincent Roché
item.description: Paris-based art director and illustrator Vincent Roché creates striking visual worlds using deep shadows, bold color and cinematic composition.

item.title: Rams System Icons: A Digital Tribute to Dieter Rams
item.description: Chinese digital artists Lu Yan, aka elliot9, and Zhiyi Zhang pay tribute to Dieter Rams with Rams System Icons, a beautifully crafted series of hyper-realistic 3D icons inspired by the legendary designer’s product language.

item.title: Atmospheric Sci-Fi Worlds by Charles Downman
item.description: London-based concept artist and digital painter Charles Downman creates cinematic sci-fi scenes filled with neon-lit streets, retro-futuristic vehicles, massive spacecraft and moody cinematic environments.

item.title: Sharp Angles: Geometric Illustrations by Jun Takahashi
item.description: Tokyo-based illustrator Jun Takahashi creates sharp characters and scenes using flat color, angular shapes and elegant visual economy.

item.title: This Pocket-Sized Printer Turns Your Designs Into Tattoos, Stickers and T-Shirt Transfers
item.description: Most creative gadgets are one-trick machines, each one taking up space and eating into your hard-earned cash for a single job. The INKWON Tag takes a more flexible approach.
